name: Burning Blade Coven
summary: In the northern cliffs of the Valley of Trials, the Burning Blade Coven threatens the Horde’s newest recruits. Corrupted cultists and summoned demons haunt the old mineral caves, using them as a staging ground for dark magic on Durotar’s doorstep.

sections.title: A Shadow Over the Proving Grounds
sections.body: Dark rituals now trouble the caves along the Valley of Trials’ northern edge. Imps and lesser fiends spill from the cavern mouth, stirring chaos and threatening the young orcs and Darkspear trolls who train here for service to the Horde. The Burning Blade cult has entrenched itself deep inside, led by the shadowy warlock Yarrog Baneshadow. What was a testing wilderness is now an active battleground against demonic corruption.

sections.title: Corruption in the Rocks
sections.body: Before demons took root in the caves, local overseers hoped to harvest their raw materials for the settlement. Foreman Thazz'ril ventured inside on a mineral survey, but the cultists drove him out in haste, and he left valuable equipment behind. Driving back Baneshadow's coven is now the ultimate proving trial for aspiring warriors, rogues, and spellcasters before they are deemed ready to venture into greater Durotar.

faq.q: Where is the Burning Blade Coven located?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade Coven occupies caves in the high red rock ridges along the Valley of Trials’ northern edge in Durotar.
The warlock Yarrog Baneshadow leads the coven, directs its rituals, and commands its summoned demons.

faq.q: What kinds of enemies lurk inside?
aliases: what mobs are in the cave
faq.answer: The caves hold rogue imps, minor demonic servitors, and mortal acolytes aligned with the Burning Blade cult.

faq.q: Why do new recruits go into the cave?
faq.answer: New orc and troll adventurers brave the cave’s depths, recover lost tools such as Foreman Thazz'ril's pick, and slay Yarrog Baneshadow as their final initiation rite before leaving the valley.

angles.text: As a warlock, you see an early cautionary glimpse of demonic imps and dark rituals here, where fel power is wielded recklessly.

As an orc, you can see the Burning Blade cult’s presence near the Valley of Trials as an intolerable insult to Thrall's new Horde and a stark reminder of the demon worship the orcs fought to leave behind.
